title: ForeSightGuide: An Anticipatory Framework toward Accurate and Low-Redundancy Guidance for the Visually Impaired
summary: An anticipatory assistive-guidance framework that combines semantic scene understanding with predicted obstacle motion to suppress non-threatening objects and produce concise guidance for visually impaired travelers.

mechanisms.name: Anticipatory low-redundancy BLV guidance
mechanisms.description: Uses predictive hazard assessment rather than reactive object mention alone to filter non-threatening objects and reduce redundant guidance while retaining hazard coverage.
mechanisms.limitations: This is a recent preprint with paper-reported benchmark and dataset results. It has not been independently reproduced for BlindAssist, and low redundancy or a low missed-hazard rate does not establish real-world BLV benefit, product readiness, or safety.
